vulnerability.title: Ensure nss-tools is installed
vulnerability.description: The nss-tools package can be installed with the following command: $ sudo dnf install nss-tools
vulnerability.recommendation: Remediation script: if ! rpm -q --quiet "nss-tools" ; then dnf install -y "nss-tools" fi

triage_decision.reason: The nss-tools package provides essential utilities for the Name Service Switch; installing it ensures proper NSS functionality and prevents related authentication issues.
triage_decision.estimated_impact: Missing package may cause NSS-related authentication failures
